name: Boro PlusAyurvedic Antiseptic Cream 40gm
description:
Boroplus Ayurvedic Antiseptic Cream

Description:
Boroplus Ayurvedic Antiseptic Cream is India’s leading multipurpose skincare solution. Enriched with 10 Ayurvedic herbs, it provides 24-hour moisturization and versatile care for your skin, making it perfect for daily use—day or night.

Key Benefits:

All-in-One Skincare: Can be used as a lip balm, for cracked heels, dry hands, minor wounds, rashes, or burns.

Herbal Healing: Contains Hedychium spicatum, Santalum album, and Aloe barbadensis to heal, protect, and moisturize skin.

Safe & Gentle: Free from parabens, silicones, and animal products.

Comprehensive Care: Ideal for dry skin, chapped lips, nappy rash, and minor burns.

Value for Money: Multiple benefits in one cream at a competitive price.

A simple, efficient, and natural solution for healthy, nourished, and protected skin.
